prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person in a black zip-up hoodie with a pink drawstring, black pants, and bright green sneakers"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06"].

message.content: {"matches":["P02"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P02 is wearing a black zip-up hoodie with a visible pink drawstring, black pants, and bright green sneakers in both crops. All other individuals either lack the hoodie, have different footwear, or different pants, making them non-matches."}

parsed.reason: P02 is wearing a black zip-up hoodie with a visible pink drawstring, black pants, and bright green sneakers in both crops. All other individuals either lack the hoodie, have different footwear, or different pants, making them non-matches.
